grounded_evidence.sv001_causal_boundary: The 2019 scoring explanation is grounded as contemporaneous Judgment/context; the stronger claim that an assay/scoring fix caused later success remains unpromoted.
grounded_evidence.sv002_accounting_boundary: The approximately $4B estimated net impact, 2018 $5.1B intangible impairment and 2019 $1.0B remaining-value impairment are distinct claim scopes/vintages and must not be collapsed.
grounded_evidence.sv004_next_capability: Ground the ClinicalTrials.gov application/json source through the existing canonical-json parser with a JSON Pointer locator and expected structured value; do not coerce JSON into visible-text Evidence.

deferred_design_pressure.summary: ADC replay showed that a later Reality can support or undermine an earlier Judgment while correctly remaining related_milestone plus indeterminate because it is not the same semantic target. This distinction is useful but is not yet a schema primitive.
deferred_design_pressure.agent_rule: When a later trajectory reproduces this pressure, read the pressure artifact before proposing a schema change. Preserve semantic_relation and evaluation_status as-is; do not overload either field. Reopen migration consideration only when the artifact's promote_to_schema_when gate is independently satisfied.

hard_boundaries: Search results and candidate URLs are discovery material, not Evidence.
The sealed blind archive may not be rewritten, deleted, corrected in place, or retroactively improved.
Any discrepancy with blind memory must be recorded in this run or a later repair/verification artifact.
Candidate sources become Longcycle Evidence only after normal fetch/archive/locator persistence and claim-scoped authority review.
Same-upstream corporate reposts or filings must not be counted as independent evidence merely because URLs differ.
A verifiable complete original PDF may be acquired through a stable redistributor, but retrieval host and upstream document identity must remain distinct.
Grounded Evidence execution may not auto-promote FactAssertions or Judgments.
next_stage_goal: Add only the missing generic JSON grounding capability, then ground the six-source SV-004 RC48 pack and test whether existing generic entity/relation semantics preserve originator, licensee, parent-company, trial-sponsor, collaborator, territory and regulatory-state distinctions without adding pharma-specific schema.
